# webtables/if

> Conditional: `if`, `elif`, `else`, as nested blocks.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/if.pkg) · translates [std/if](../std/if.md)

Each branch is a block that its condition leaves when false
(`br_if`), and that jumps to the end of the whole `if` when it is done:
the same order of evaluation as bintables' jumps.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(block ${L.end}
(block ${L.next}
(br_if ${L.next} (i64.eqz
{cond}
))
{then}
(br ${L.end}))
{each elif}
(block ${it.L.next}
(br_if ${it.L.next} (i64.eqz
{it.cond}
))
{it.then}
(br ${L.end}))
{end}
{else}
)
```
